title: Methanol-to-electricity via low-temperature steam reforming integrated with a high-temperature PEM fuel cell
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5627-5634
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00703H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Aziz Ur Rehman, Christian H. Schwarz, Sina Souzani, Christian Heßke, Marco Haumann
Methanol reforming is carried out at ultra-low temperatures around 423 K catalyzed by supported liquid phase molecular Pu-pincer catalysts (Ru-SLP). The formed hydrogen is directly fed to a HTPEM fuel cell to demonstrate the feasibility.
